title: FBI-UAP-D017, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-2, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A dark nighttime landscape shows two human figures seen from behind, standing side by side in the left-center foreground and outlined with a soft yellow-green glow. Both figures appear to be adults; the left one is slightly taller and wears what looks like a jacket, while the right one wears a top and pants. They face toward a low range of brown, rocky hills that stretch across the middle of the frame. Above the hills is a deep blue star-filled sky with numerous scattered white dots representing stars, and a small bright yellow-white circular light resembling a moon in the upper right area. The foreground ground is very dark with faint bluish highlights.

observations.claim: Two human figures stand in the foreground viewed from behind
The figures are outlined with a soft glowing rim light
A range of brown rocky hills spans the middle of the image
The sky is dark blue and filled with many small star-like points
A bright round light resembling a moon appears in the upper right
The left figure appears taller than the right figure
